messages:
Maria (CEO): quick sticky from today's all-hands  want a short set of clarifications we can push to GTM: how to talk about our mission vs competitors + one recommended hero line. keep replies tiny.
Ajay (CTO): mission shorthand: "make inference predictable and economical." tech note: always pair perf numbers with config (seq/batch/hw).
Lena (Head Product): recommend hero: "Inference engineered for production." it signals runtime + ops.
Tom (Sales): field: buyers split into feature teams (PLG) and platform/infra (sales). make two lead flows and two one-pagers.
Priya (Eng): practical: docs must include worst-case SLOs and fallback behavior. ops-bot: perf exports at /dashboards/perf-summary.
Darci (Strategy): competitor quick map: clouds (scale, opaque costs), tiny vendors (low-cost, thin SLAs), OSS (flexible, ops-heavy). our angle = verified models + rollout controls.
Maria (CEO): good. final quick Q  public model benchmarks: full grids or tiered summaries?
Lena (Head Product): publish vetted grids for verified models; BYOM allowed but marked experimental until verified.
Tom (Sales): please add a 1-pager comparing verified models vs common community checkpoints for demo rebuttals.
Priya (Eng): i'll draft a BYOM checklist: quant support, max-seq, kv cache, memory footprint, sharding notes.
Maria (CEO): perfect. i'll fold these into a short README and two sample one-pagers (PLG + enterprise) and share later. thanks :)
